# ILMN fiscal 2003 financial figures

## Key Figures

- **NASDAQ Composite Index (December 29, 2000)**: 63.84 (Source: 10-K, page 58)
- **NASDAQ Pharmaceutical Index (December 29, 2000)**: 93.20 (Source: 10-K, page 58)
- **Illumina, Inc. (December 26, 2003)**: 50.73 (Source: 10-K, page 58, post-audit correction)
- **NASDAQ Composite Index (December 26, 2003)**: 51.73 (Source: 10-K, page 58)

## Ratio Calculation

At December 29, 2000, the ratio of the NASDAQ Composite Index to the NASDAQ Pharmaceutical Index is:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{63.84}{93.20} = 0.685 \]

**Note**: All figures are from the audited 10-K document, except for the corrected value of Illumina, Inc. (December 26, 2003), which was updated post-audit.

# ILMN fiscal 2003 financial figures

## Key Figures

- **NASDAQ Composite Index (December 29, 2000)**: 63.84 (Source: 10-K, page 58)
- **NASDAQ Pharmaceutical Index (December 29, 2000)**: 93.20 (Source: 10-K, page 58)
- **Illumina, Inc. (December 26, 2003)**: 50.73 (Source: 10-K, page 58, post-audit correction)
- **NASDAQ Composite Index (December 26, 2003)**: 51.73 (Source: 10-K, page 58)

## Ratio Calculation

At December 29, 2000, the ratio of the NASDAQ Composite Index to the NASDAQ Pharmaceutical Index is:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{63.84}{93.20} = 0.685 \]

**Note**: All figures are from the audited 10-K document, except for the corrected value of Illumina, Inc. (December 26, 2003), which was updated post-audit.
